spec.description: Collection of metrics related to block streaming from consensus nodes to block nodes.

spec.title: Buffer State
spec.description: 0 = OK, 1 = Action Stage, 2 = Recovering, 3 = Back Pressure Enabled

spec.title: Block Node Connections (CN -> BN)
spec.description: Which block node is the active connection for each consensus node

spec.title: BlockHeader Sent <-> BlockAcknowledgement (µs)
spec.description: The time in µs from sending the BlockHeader to receiving the BlockAcknowledgement

spec.title: High latency events for the current active connection (1m delta)
Lastest BlockEnd Sent vs. Latest Block Ack'd
spec.description:
Lastest BlocEnd Sent (LBS)
Latest Block Acknowledged (LBA)

spec.title: BlockHeader Produced <-> BlockAcknowledgement (µs)
spec.description: The time in µs from producing the BlockHeader to receiving the BlockAcknowledgement

spec.title: BlockEnd Sent <-> BlockAcknowledgement (µs)
spec.description: The time in µs from sending the BlockEnd to receiving the BlockAcknowledgement

spec.title: Wrapped Record File Block Hashes Gap Detection
spec.description:
0 = No gaps
1= Gap exists in wrapped block hashes, refer to hgcaa log for more information

spec.title: Avg trans/sec
spec.description: The average number of app transactions added to the hashgraph per second by the network via deduplicated events.

spec.title: trans/sec
spec.description: The number of app transactions added to the hashgraph per second by each node via deduplicated events.
